label: 1x8 PLC splitter, SC/APC, FHD cassette
description: 1x8 balanced planar-lightwave-circuit splitter in an FHD cassette, operating 1260-1650 nm with SC/APC connectors on the common input and all 8 output legs. Insertion loss <=10.5 dB, PDL <=0.2 dB, return loss >=55 dB (APC); fully passive, carries GPON and XGS-PON wavelengths transparently.
